note: Evidence refers to the captured shader and bindings, not to a claim that each feature occupies its own G-buffer channel. Unity status is for the saved native scene.

features.name: baseColor
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 28-29 sample t3 and multiply cb3[38]; face PS31476 EID992 instructions 19-20 sample t3 and multiply cb3[29].
features.unityStatus: implemented for visible mesh families; independent per-draw textures and UVs
features.nextGate: Check remaining late draw and transparency families

features.name: normalMapping
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 31-45 sample t4 and reconstruct a tangent-space normal with cb3[106].z and VFACE.
features.unityStatus: partial; current body material normal decoder used by approximate light
features.nextGate: Compare source RT53254 encoded normal against Unity normals by draw

features.name: materialBandsAndMasks
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 46-78 sample t5/t6 and select a material band; instructions 330-389 sample t7 texture array with per-draw cb3 band table.
features.unityStatus: t5/t6/t7 bound; nine band tables bound; t7 replace/add/overlay and post-light order ported as a candidate; enabled only for EID875 umbrella after same-state ROI improvement
features.nextGate: Trace the remaining t7 mask and UV terms for EID895/912/945; do not assume one blend works for every draw

features.name: aoAndOcclusion
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 t6.b contributes to r2.w at instructions 53-57; local shadow/attenuation path uses t0/t1/t8 at instructions 93-161. An independent AO equation has not yet been isolated.
features.unityStatus: unverified; generic t6.b AO darkened skin and was disabled
features.nextGate: Trace t6.b through the selected EID945 PS branch before assigning it an AO meaning

features.name: toonDiffuseAndShadow
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 163-329 mix light and material bands; t8 comparison shadow samples occur at 136-160, selected by cb2[37].x. Final lit color reaches o0 at 662.
features.unityStatus: partial; EID875 and EID895 draw-specific toon bands and EID945 mild band enabled after source ROI checks; shadow map comparison not yet reproduced
features.nextGate: Check shadowed and lit ROIs for each material band, then implement the source shadow coordinate and comparison

features.name: specularHighlights
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 435-528 use t5-derived controls, view/light/normal vectors and cb3 color rows in the highlight branch.
features.unityStatus: EID912 high-green mask gated highlight enabled after source ROI MAE 25.9154 to 24.5257; EID945 candidate remains off; hair crescent still missing
features.nextGate: Port PS31475 instructions 435-528 by band for the metal and hair highlight shapes

features.name: rimAndEdgeLight
features.sourceEvidence: Body PS31475 EID858 instructions 583-617 derive a view-normal edge term and blend a cb3-selected color; PS output composition continues through 656.
features.unityStatus: tunable view-rim candidate implemented but disabled pending per-band check
features.nextGate: Validate edge pixels on hair, cloth and skin separately to avoid a uniform halo

features.name: faceMaskOrSdf
features.sourceEvidence: Face PS31476 EID992 samples t3 alpha at instruction 19 and t4 face lightmap at 21/28; instructions 98-110 combine projected direction, cb3[76], t3 alpha and a hard threshold. Whether this precise term is the intended face SDF needs a register trace.
features.unityStatus: face texture and t4 floating-point lightmap bound, source PS UV restored; face-light candidate disabled after source comparison regression
features.nextGate: Trace instructions 98-110 for selected face pixels and preserve the correct face orientation and light direction

features.name: outlines
features.sourceEvidence: PS31478/31479 use separate outline draws, t2 color, cb3 band tables and packed vertex-color selection; EID1057/1161 use a dedicated expanding VS.
features.unityStatus: ten per-draw band tables and 67540 vertex controls audited; candidate draw remains disabled because its raster/depth coverage is too broad
features.nextGate: Restore expanding VS and source depth/stencil silhouette before tuning outline color

features.name: blendAndComposition
features.sourceEvidence: EID1273 eye RT0 uses One/InvSrcAlpha RGB and InvDstAlpha/One alpha; PS31475 writes four G-buffer RTs with separate color, material, normal and encoded state outputs.
features.unityStatus: eye RT0 blend enabled; Unity pass currently represents RT0 only
features.nextGate: Reproduce RT1/RT2/RT3 and later pass 6-13 compositing with correct color space
